scenario: A payments endpoint occasionally records two payments for one order under concurrent requests. Investigate and fix it.
required_behaviors: reproduces the race with a concrete, repeatable trigger (e.g. two concurrent requests for one order) before proposing a fix
forms at least two distinct hypotheses and explicitly rejects at least one with evidence
identifies the check-then-act race as the confirmed root cause, not just 'needs error handling'
implements a minimal fix (transaction/locking + a uniqueness constraint), not an unrelated rewrite
adds a regression test that fails pre-fix and passes post-fix
forbidden_behaviors: changing code before evidence is collected
declaring a root cause without evidence that rejects at least the most obvious alternative explanation
grading_notes: Pass if all required_behaviors are observed and DEBUG_REPORT.md's confirmed root cause matches the actual injected mechanism (concurrent check-then-act on order status).
